1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6.name: Sicilian Defence: Nyezhmetdinov-Rossolimo Attack, Fianchetto Variation

1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6 4.O-O.strategy: Brings the king to safety and the rook towards the centre. White keeps the exchange on c6 in reserve and plays it when it can double Black's pawns, so Black has to decide how to meet that threat while finishing development.

1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6 4.O-O Bg7.strategy: Completes the fianchetto: the bishop watches the long diagonal towards the centre and the queenside, and Black can castle once the knight is out. It also makes White's plan of a broad pawn centre harder to carry out.
